guests.name: Tuntun Yadav
guests.summary: Tuntun Yadav is a Bhojpuri singer, music director and folk artist from Ara, Bihar. He is one of the contemporary names in the Bhojpuri music industry.

guests.name: Shubham Raj
guests.summary: Shubham Raj, professionally known by his popular industry moniker SBR (or SBR ON THE MUSIC), is a multi-talented Indian singer, music composer, music producer, and audio engineer. Emerging from Bhagalpur, Bihar, and later establishing a creative base in Mumbai, Maharashtra, he has become one of the defining new-age forces in the modern Bhojpuri music industry.

guests.name: Anita Rawat
guests.summary: Anita Rawat is a dynamic and highly accomplished Indian actress who has successfully established a powerful presence in regional Indian cinema, most notably within the Bhojpuri film industry. Originally hailing from the scenic northern state of Uttarakhand, her journey into the entertainment world is marked by immense dedication, artistic versatility, and a continuous drive to overcome cultural and linguistic barriers.

guests.name: Mahi Shrivastava
guests.summary: Mahi Shrivastava is a popular Indian actress and dancer who primarily works in the Bhojpuri film and music industry.

guests.name: Dev Singh
guests.summary: Dev Singh, also known as Dev Singh Rajput, is a Bhojpuri film actor known for antagonist roles. He has worked in more than 50 films.

guests.name: Vijay Chauhan
guests.summary: Vijay Chauhan is a Bhojpuri singer, music composer, lyricist and actor. His work includes both energetic festive tracks and devotional or socially conscious music.

guests.name: Kalyani Singh
guests.summary: Kalyani Singh is an Indian actress, model and digital content creator from Bihar. She has taken part in pageants and in MTV Model 2020.

guests.name: Vinod Mishra
guests.summary: Vinod Mishra is an Indian actor, screenwriter and dialogue writer. He has worked in Bhojpuri films and Hindi television, often playing stern father and antagonist roles.
